editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the IC&RC Licensed Chemical Dependency Counselor exam by mastering all four domains, 150 questions, and 180 minutes of content.
editorial.overview: The IC&RC Licensed Chemical Dependency Counselor certification exam assesses practitioner knowledge across four distinct and detailed domains. Certified by IC&RC, this evaluation covers the scientific principles of substance use, evidence-based screening procedures, advanced treatment practices, and professional responsibilities to ensure qualified care delivery and proper clinical practice.
editorial.who_should_take: Practitioners seeking professional certification in substance use disorder treatment. Candidates need preparation in clinical evaluation, treatment planning, counseling, service coordination, and adherence to legal and ethical standards.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the four domains very carefully and align your daily study habits with the precise weighted distribution specified by the official guide. Focus on scientific principles, screening methods, treatment methodologies, and legal duties. Practice answering questions under timed conditions to manage the 180-minute duration effectively.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the core scientific principles of substance use disorders along with associated co-occurring disorders, representing an important 25.0 percent portion of the overall examination content.

This domain emphasizes evidence-based treatment modalities, professional counseling techniques, and effective referral coordination, making up a significant 30.0 percent of the entire test to evaluate therapeutic competence.

This particular domain comprehensively addresses professional responsibilities, ethical standards, and legal requirements, covering 25.0 percent of the exam content to ensure that candidates maintain proper regulatory and moral practices during client care.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive early with all required identification documents. Pace yourself carefully across the 150 questions during the 180 minutes allowed, ensuring you review flagged items before time expires.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The official certification examination consists of a total of 150 questions covering four distinct domains weighted across scientific principles, screening methods, treatment strategies, and professional ethics to test knowledge.

The established passing score required to successfully pass this professional certification examination is officially set at 500/800 points according to the established guidelines for candidates seeking credentials.
Test takers are given a total duration of 180 minutes to complete all questions included in the evaluation and demonstrate their professional competency across all mandatory core subjects.
The credential certification is officially issued by IC&RC. For long-term certification path details, check with IC&RC directly regarding current requirements and policies for all future applicants.

methodology.summary: This page was compiled using official IC&RC documentation and technical publication guides to present accurate domain weights and exam structures for candidates preparing for the credential.
